turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on polite requests?
turns.tutor:
Let me fix one first: "Pass me the salt."
Step 1: This is an order. It can sound rude.
Step 2: I change the start to "Can I have".
Step 3: I add please at the end.
Result: Can I have the salt, please?
Rule: to ask nicely, start with "Can I have" and add please.
Right: Can I have a sandwich, please? Wrong: Bring me a sandwich.
Now you. Write one polite sentence:
Make this polite: "Give me a coffee."
